name: Verify a sensitive request
guidance: Confirm the requester through an independently known channel and check the agreed approval process.

name: Check a sensitive handoff
guidance: Confirm the recipient, use the agreed sharing channel and limit access to the intended material.

name: Confirm handoff ownership
guidance: Obtain acknowledgement from the receiving owner and include the evidence, uncertainty and next action.

name: Review account protection
guidance: Have the identity owner review MFA and the privileges needed for this engagement.

name: Review endpoint posture
guidance: Have the device owner review management status, active protection and the update baseline.
